items.t: VC-Turbo engine bearing failure (recall)
items.job: Inspect oil pan, change oil, update software; replace engine if damaged (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking activates for no reason
items.job: Apply software bulletin and recalibrate radar and camera
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the radar sensor or bracket must be replaced.

items.t: Passenger airbag light from failed seat sensor
items.job: Replace passenger seat cushion with occupant sensor
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes of about $2,800 to $5,100. Independent shops and used seat cushions cost less.

items.t: Dashboard gets sticky, melts or cracks
items.note: One owner was quoted about $3,250. A fitted dash cover is a far cheaper fix for glare.

items.t: Engine loses power or shuts off while driving
items.note: Parts depend on the cause. An ignition coil is cheap; internal engine damage is very expensive.

items.t: Transmission speed sensor fault and poor acceleration
items.note: Major transmission repairs cost far more.

items.t: Steering wheel locks up
items.job: Replace electronic steering lock and program it
items.note: A new lock must be programmed to the car, so this is usually a dealer job.

items.t: Steering shaft can develop play or separate (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag may switch off with an adult seated (recall)
items.job: Test occupant sensor and replace seat cushion if needed (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not work after a dead battery (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power steering groans and gets heavy
items.note: A worn steering rack costs more to replace.

items.t: Brake rotors warp and pulse early
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: One owner average was about $500.

items.t: Cracked radiator leaks coolant
items.note: Owners report about $1,200 total.

items.t: Doors won't unlock or open in cold weather
items.note: One owner reports $800 for a driver door part at the dealer.

items.t: Engine idles low or stalls at a stop
items.job: Clean throttle body and perform idle relearn

items.t: Fuel pump buzzing from the back seat area
items.job: Inspect fuel pump (usually no repair needed)

items.t: No-start or false warning lights from water in a wiring harness
items.job: Dry and repair wet wiring harness connectors

items.t: Harsh downshifts or hesitation when slowing
Weak acceleration or slow braking from damaged brake wiring
Check engine light from EVAP leak codes
items.job: Find and fix EVAP leak (smoke test, cap, valve or hose)

items.t: Sunroof glass shatters
items.note: Comprehensive insurance often covers broken glass.

items.t: Backup camera stops working
Key not recognized at start
items.job: Diagnose Intelligent Key system; replace key or key slot if needed
items.note: Low end is a new fob battery.

items.t: Roaring cooling fan and weak A/C
items.job: Replace cooling fan assembly per bulletin
items.note: May be covered under warranty; check with the dealer.

items.t: Infotainment freezes or audio won't turn on
Moonroof rattles, pops or creaks
items.note: A full moonroof assembly replacement costs much more.

items.t: Underbody shield comes loose
Passenger knee airbag cover may break off in the cold (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image can be switched off (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Steering knuckle or rear axle housing may be weak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering knuckle or rear axle housing (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger door may not lock (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Tire sidewall may be cut from the factory (service campaign)
items.job: Inspect and replace cut tires (service campaign)
items.note: Free under Infiniti campaign PC911 for affected vehicles.

items.t: Driver airbag may not deploy properly (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Panoramic roof glass shatters while driving
items.note: Comprehensive insurance often covers broken glass.
